keys.manual_admin.tools.mantenimiento.title: Maintenance
keys.manual_admin.tools.mantenimiento.desc: Cleanup and restart actions in the sidebar menu. All of them ask for confirmation before running.
keys.manual_admin.tools.mantenimiento.uploads: Deletes orphaned media files no longer referenced by any question. This cannot be undone.
keys.manual_admin.tools.mantenimiento.cache_d: Empties the game cache. Useful if you just edited a bank and the changes do not show up in new games.
keys.manual_admin.tools.mantenimiento.logs_de: Empties the server log files (backend, Redis and backup) to free disk space.
keys.manual_admin.tools.mantenimiento.panic_d: Forced restart of the Docker container. All active games are lost. Use it only in emergencies.
